SELECT t1.user_id, t1.user_name, t1.nick_name, t1.sex, t1.phonenumber, t1.create_time, t1.`status` FROM `sys_user` AS t1 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role AS t3 ON t1.user_id = t3.user_id WHERE t3.role_id = 4 AND t1.del_flag = 0
AND t1.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickName}, '%')
ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC
SELECT t1.user_id, t1.user_name, t1.password, t1.nick_name, t1.age, t1.sex, t1.birthday, t1.phonenumber, t1.grade, t1.`status` FROM `sys_user` AS t1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND t1.del_flag = 0
